name: Cobrá Relayer
description: Cobrá is a LatAm merchant checkout on Celo. Merchants create invoices in local currency from Telegram; payers sign once (EIP-3009 or Permit2, bound to the full payment intent) and this agent relays CobraRouter.pay(), paying the gas, so the merchant receives the exact wFIAT amount. It can only submit the exact signed intent (it cannot change merchant, amount, token, path or split), enforces per-payment and per-day USD caps, and tags every tx with ERC-8021. It also sells an FX quote over x402 (GET /api/x402/fx-quote?currency=ARS|BRL&amount=N, 0.001 USD₮ or USDC per call): what it costs to deliver an exact wARS or wBRL amount on Celo.
